edition.name: Migne, Patrologia Latina 5 (1844), via Latin Wikisource
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Incolae coelorum futuri cum Deo Christo Tenente principium, vidente cuncta de coelo. Simplicitas, bonitas, habitet in corpore vestro. Irasci nolite sine causa fratri devoto: Recipietis enim quidquid feceritis ab illo. Hoc placuit Christo, resurgere mortuos, imo, Cum suis corporibus, et quos ignis ussit in aevo, Sex millibus annis completis mundo finito. Vertitur interea coelum tenore mutato: Comburuntur enim impii tunc igne divino. Ira Dei summi ardet creatura gemendo. Digniores, stemmate et generati praeclaro, Nobilesque viri sub Antichristo devicto: Ex praecepto Dei rursum viventes in aevo, Mille quidem annis ut serviant sanctis et Alto, Sub jugo servili, ut portent victualia collo; Ut iterum autem judicentur regno finito. Nullificantes Deum, completo millesimo anno, Ab igne peribunt, cum montibus ipsi loquendo. In bustis et tumulis omnis caro redditur acto, Demerguntur inferno, trahunt poenas in aevo. Ostenduntur illis, et legunt gesta de coelo Memoria prisca debito et merita digno. Merces in perpetuo secundum facta tyranno. Omnia non possum comprehendere parvo libello. Curiositas docti inveniet nomen in isto.
pass_a_gloss: Inhabitants of future heavens with God Christ holding the beginning, seeing all things from heaven. Simplicity, goodness, let it dwell in your body. Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother: For you will receive whatever you do from him. This pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, indeed, with their bodies, and those whom fire has burned in the age, when six thousand years are completed the world is finished. Meanwhile the heaven is turned with a changed tenor: For the wicked are burned then with divine fire. The creature groans with the anger of God the highest burning. More worthy, of noble lineage and born of famous stock, and noble men under Antichrist defeated: Living again by the command of God in the age, for a thousand years so that they may serve the saints and the High One, under a servile yoke, so that they may carry provisions on their neck; So that they may be judged again when the kingdom is finished. Those who nullify God, when the thousandth year is completed, will perish from fire, when the mountains themselves speak. All flesh is returned to the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, they drag punishments in the age. Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven from ancient memory and worthy merit. Reward in perpetuity according to the deeds to the tyrant. I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book. The curiosity of the learned will find a name in this.
pass_b_english: The inhabitants of the future heavens will see all things from above as God Christ holds the beginning.
Let simplicity and goodness dwell in your body.
Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother, for you will receive whatever you do from him.
This pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, indeed, with their bodies, and those whom fire has burned in the age, when six thousand years are completed and the world is finished.
Meanwhile, the heaven is turned with a changed tenor, for the wicked are burned then with divine fire.
The creature groans with the anger of God the Highest burning.

More worthy, of noble lineage and born of famous stock, and noble men under Antichrist defeated, living again by the command of God in the age, for a thousand years so that they may serve the saints and the High One, under a servile yoke, so that they may carry provisions on their neck, so that they may be judged again when the kingdom is finished.
Those who nullify God, when the thousandth year is completed, will perish from fire, when the mountains themselves speak.
All flesh is returned to the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, and they drag punishments in the age.
Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven from ancient memory and worthy merit.
Reward in perpetuity according to the deeds to the tyrant.
I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book.
The curiosity of the learned will find a name in this.
